Hi Liam — thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap: Novacore is focused on predictable inference for your agents (low-variance latency at 95th pct), tighter cost controls for bursty usage, and a compliance footprint suitable for regulated customers. From our call it sounds like the next useful step is a technical runthrough with our ML/Infra engineers to walk the proposed serving pattern, MLPipeline -> Redwood routing, and an ops/playbook review.

Goal: 60–90 minute runthrough for engineering & ops owners to validate performance profile and surface any integration blockers. Proposed agenda (30–60 min demo + 20–30 min ops/rollout Q&A + 10 min next steps):
- Quick context (5 min)
- Serving runtime demo: batching, KV-prefix caching, and fallback variants (30 min)
- Autoscaling and capacity guardrails (15 min)
- Security/compliance checklist and data flow diagram (10 min)
- Open Q&A and next steps (10–20 min)

Suggested windows (all PT):
- Tue Jul 13 — 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed Jul 14 — 09:30–11:00 or 15:00–16:30
- Fri Jul 16 — 11:00–12:30

Please let me know which window works for you and who from Novacore will join (engineering lead + ops/security preferred). I’ll loop in our infra lead (Marcus) and ops owner (Marissa) once we lock.

Attachments: draft mutual action plan stub attached (Novacore_MAP_v1.pdf) — outlines success criteria and decision owners.

Thanks,
